as_of_means: The date of the last live crawl, not today. This feed goes visibly out of date rather than silently.

awaiting_minutes.basis: an agenda posted for a past date whose file id has no minutes alongside it in the town's listing. This is minutes against AGENDAS, not against meetings held -- the same proxy sources/data/minutes-coverage.csv rests on, and the town publishes nothing that reconciles the two.

first_seen_means: The day our crawler first saw a document. The town publishes no posting timestamp, so a gap between a meeting and its minutes appearing is an UPPER BOUND on how long the town took, never a measurement of it. Documents adopted when the watch was seeded have no first_seen and are excluded from every lag figure.
not_a_measurement: This file records what the Lunenburg Budget Project's crawler could see on the town's AgendaCenter on the date given. It is not a figure checked against a document, and it must not be presented beside one as the same kind of number.

recent.basis: one row per meeting from sources/data/meeting-register.csv -- the one record a meeting has -- for past meetings the town posted or published something about in the window; every artifact we hold for it is on the row. Newest activity first.

our_minutes.headline: Board referred Pratt Street speeding to police; food pantry suspends operations; flag policy leans restrictive.
Planning Board endorsed five ANR plans and approved a shared-driveway special permit at 760 Goodrich Street.
Select Board and design committee toured Brooks House and TCP in person to assess building condition ahead of a future decision on the properties.
Sewer Commission approved added flow for two basement bedrooms and discussed rising FY28 costs and user fees.
Select Board kept a single tax rate with no exemptions and approved three Verizon conduit petitions.
Open Space Committee kept working on land-acquisition criteria, adding an underserved-areas test, and set an in-person December 9 meeting.
Planning Board approved a bus operations site plan at 199 Mass Ave with six conditions, after a de minimis change.
Cable committee began planning Comcast license renewal with its lawyer; no votes beyond minutes and adjournment.
Cemetery Commission approved updated rules and regulations and set a noon Dec 2 meeting to fund the back-lot expansion.

our_minutes.headline: Committee moved to oppose a separate stormwater utility and to ask the state delegation to help with a liquor license.
Library trustees approved amended October minutes; the food forest grant is still undecided on the governor's desk.
Capital committee heard fire and police capital plans and questioned a third ambulance; only adjournment was voted.
Assessors voted to recommend a single tax rate and no residential exemption, small commercial exemption or open space discount.
Council on Aging sent a member's seven bylaw-change proposals to a four-member subcommittee and backed an architect study and emergency shower.

our_minutes.headline: Committee heard a first-draft FY28 budget up about 10.77%, took no vote, and voted to send a Collins Center study to FinCom.
Conservation Commission continued all three hearings to Dec 2 and ratified a beaver-dam emergency order at Flat Hill.
Sewer Commission voted to send a delinquent Sunny Hill Road account to the tax collector with no payment plan.
Planning Board approved the 30 School Street food pantry site plan with conditions and backed housekeeping zoning changes.
Sewer Commission approved moving money into the connection fees line to pay Leominster's per-connection charges.
Planning Board approved both 10 Parmenter Road phases and 149 Summer Street; the 30 School Street food pantry hearing was continued to October 19.
School Committee voted 4-0 to back Article 9 track and field engineering, funded from general stabilization.
Personnel Committee unanimously approved the assistant town manager job description so the job can be posted again.

upcoming.basis: an agenda posted for a date on or after as_of. An agenda is not a guarantee the meeting happens, and a meeting can be held with no agenda posted.
